scope: Stage 4: vrct-graphics bundled into the CPU and CUDA sidecars from the production specs (hidden import, licenses/vrct-graphics), validation builds via tools/check_frozen_e2e.py; inside each exe the hook builds a D3D11 session, uploads a frame, composes with a mask using the embedded shaders and reads it back (bit-exact), and real Whisper runs over IPC.
